reuse.why: No shared category-selection helper exists to reuse, and the diff does not create one; it threads the flag through each existing copy of the query and the copyPreviousMonth filter.

duplication.why: The same `${includeHiddenCategories ? '' : 'AND c.hidden = 0 AND g.hidden = 0'}` fragment is pasted into five identical SQL queries plus a sixth variant in copyPreviousMonth, extending the existing duplication instead of consolidating it.

placement.why: Changes sit in budget/actions.ts where the month-wide actions live, and the handler types pick the new argument up through typeof.

scope.why: Only the six month-wide actions and one test are touched.

maintainability.why: The hidden rule is now decided in six places with string-interpolated SQL; a future change to the selection rule must again be applied to every copy.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplication is plain repetition of the same conditional SQL fragment across setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg, not disguised.
